title: The record's context field is redacted at record construction, not at emission
asA: operator concerned about PII in error records
iWant: the context field on the record to be redacted at construction time by the logging companion's redaction categories
soThat: the record itself never carries un-redacted PII even if the emitter fails to redact

acceptanceCriteria.description: createErrorRecord({..., context: {email: 'x@y', ip: '1.2.3.4'}}) with pii.email in the redaction category set returns a record whose context.email equals [REDACTED:pii.email]; the caller's original context object is not mutated.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a call to the factory with a context object carrying a pii.email field
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned record's context.email equals [REDACTED:pii.email] and the caller's context object still holds the original value
